name: Demon
soul: The soul of one who will not be told, and would rather be wrong on their own account than right on another's.
spark: The mote will not come when it is called. It comes a little after, as if it had thought of it itself.

hybrid.text: It answers to nobody. It has made one exception, and does not care to have it mentioned.

newFeatures.label: a crown of its own horns
two arms more than it was born with

settled.name: Princeling
settled.text: Knee-high, with its chin up and two buds of horn. It has never once come when it was called; it turns up a little after, on business of its own.
settled.sign: Two buds of horn, small hooves, wings no bigger than its hands, and a tail it cannot keep still.
settled.habit: Told to get down off the table, it stays up there one minute more, so that getting down is its own idea.

paths.name: Exile
paths.of: one who left rather than be told, and has not looked back to check
paths.text: It learned from you that some rooms can only be left. It left with its head up and kept the crown, which broke on the way out.
paths.sign: A cracked crown worn low between its horns, its wings round its shoulders like a short cloak, and a very straight back.
paths.habit: It sits a little apart at every table, and is put out if nobody remarks on it.

prongs.name: Pretender
prongs.of: one who keeps a rank that nobody else recognises
prongs.text: Nobody crowned it. It has gone on behaving exactly as if somebody had, for so long that people have begun to stand up.
prongs.sign: The crown mended with wire and worn dead straight, its wings up behind its head like a collar, its horns grown long.
prongs.habit: It waits at a door to be announced. You have caught yourself doing the announcing.

finishes.name: Court of One
finishes.of: one who rules a country of a single subject, and rules it well
finishes.text: It holds court wherever you sit down. There is one subject. The subject has never once been kept waiting.
finishes.sign: Seven horns stand in a ring where the crown was, and the back of a throne is strapped behind its shoulders.
finishes.habit: It grants you things you already had: the window seat, the last of the bread, your own name.

finishes.name: Stiff-neck
finishes.of: one who would not bow the head, and now has none to bow
finishes.text: It would not bow its head to anyone. In the end the head went, and the not bowing stayed, and burns where it was.
finishes.sign: Above the collar there is no head. A crown of flame stands there with two eyes in it, and the horns still either side.
finishes.habit: It nods to nobody. It will incline the flame a very little, to you, at breakfast.

prongs.name: Door-keeper
prongs.of: one who left, and kept the door they left by
prongs.text: It took the door with it when it went. Nobody has been able to shut it out since, there being nothing to shut.
prongs.sign: A small shut door is strapped to its back, hinges and all. One horn broke on the lintel. The key is at its belt.
prongs.habit: It shuts every door behind you both, gently, and tries the handle after.

finishes.name: Door Left Ajar
finishes.of: one who went first so that whoever came after would find it open
finishes.text: It leaves the door a hand's width open now, with a light behind it, for whoever is still deciding whether to go.
finishes.sign: The door on its back stands a hand open, and the light of the field comes through the gap in one long bar.
finishes.habit: It will not shut the last door of the evening. It leaves it on the latch, in case.

finishes.name: Bolted Door
finishes.of: one who will not be followed, and has seen to it
finishes.text: The door is barred across in iron now, and it carries it in front. What it left is not coming after it. Nor is anything else.
finishes.sign: The door has come round onto its arm, barred and bolted. It stands behind it as behind a wall.
finishes.habit: It checks the bolt with its thumb whenever anybody says the word home.

prongs.name: Fly-by-night
prongs.of: one who left after dark, by the window, and found they could fly
prongs.text: It left by the window, at night, on wings it had not known it had until it was already out.
prongs.sign: Two wings of skin held half open, as if it has just landed or is about to go. It prefers the sill to the room.
prongs.habit: It sleeps by the window with one wing over its head, and is gone and back before you wake.

finishes.name: Long Way Round
finishes.of: one who would sooner go a hundred miles than ask the way once
finishes.text: It has never once asked the way. It has seen a great deal of country because of that, and regrets none of it.
finishes.sign: Wings wide enough to cross a valley on, long ringed horns laid back, and the look of having come a great distance.
finishes.habit: Shown a short cut, it thanks you, and goes the way it was going.

finishes.name: Moonless
finishes.of: one who is most themselves when nobody at all can see
finishes.text: On the darkest nights it lets go of its edges. There is a shape with two eyes in it, and it is perfectly at ease.
finishes.sign: Its wings are wrapped round it like a cloak, and where the cloak ends it is going to smoke. One horn. Two eyes.
finishes.habit: It puts the lamp out with its fingers when you have fallen asleep, and sits on in the dark.

paths.name: Advocate
paths.of: one who can make the case for anything, and enjoys it
paths.text: It learned from you that nearly anything can be argued, and that being hit for it is no reason to stop. It finishes the sentence.
paths.sign: A good coat with gold at the cuffs, whose tails are its own folded wings, and one hand always a little out.
paths.habit: It argues you out of the last cake, and then gives you half.

prongs.name: Fair Offer
prongs.of: one who holds out the thing you wanted before you had said so
prongs.text: It always has something in its hand that you want. It tells you the price first, and the price is always exactly what it said.
prongs.sign: A small light rides in its left hand. The right is kept behind its back, and is empty; it will show you.
prongs.habit: It offers you a bite of whatever it is eating before you have looked at it twice.

finishes.name: Gilded Hand
finishes.of: one whose gifts are real, and cost exactly what was agreed
finishes.text: Everything it has handed over has been worth it, and paid for. The hand it gives with has gone to gold to the elbow.
finishes.sign: Its right arm is gold from the fingers to the elbow, and held a little away from the rest of it, like something lent.
finishes.habit: It pays for everything on the nail, yours included, and tells you afterwards what you owe.

finishes.name: Second Helping
finishes.of: one who wants a little more, and has stopped pretending otherwise
finishes.text: It wants things, and it says so. It has a second mouth, below the first, which says so more plainly.
finishes.sign: A wide second mouth across its belly, with good teeth. The upper mouth makes the conversation.
finishes.habit: It finishes what is on your plate while explaining, quite fairly, why you did not want it.

prongs.name: Both Sides
prongs.of: one who argues both sides, and means both
prongs.text: It can put your case better than you can, and then the other one. It is not being false. It believes whichever it is saying.
prongs.sign: A second face looks out from the back of its head. One horn curls forward and one back, and its coat is of two halves.
prongs.habit: It loses arguments to itself, out loud, on the stairs.

finishes.name: Full Bench
finishes.of: one who has taken every side and now sits as all of them
finishes.text: There are several of it now, as mouths, and they hear the matter together. The finding is usually in your favour.
finishes.sign: Small mouths hang in the air about its head, each with an opinion. Its horns are rolled like a judge's wig.
finishes.habit: It puts small questions to the vote. You have one vote. It has five.

finishes.name: Last Word
finishes.of: one who has to have it, and has arranged always to have it
finishes.text: It keeps a mouth at the back of its head for leaving with. Nobody has yet had the last word on it, including you.
finishes.sign: The face behind has grown a wide mouth of its own, which goes on talking as the rest of it walks away.
finishes.habit: It says goodnight, and then one more thing from the stairs, and then one more from its bed.

prongs.name: Good Company
prongs.of: one who makes any room glad it came, and is never off its guard
prongs.text: It is the best company at any table, and it has not once forgotten whose side it is on. Yours. Only yours.
prongs.sign: Curled horns oiled to a shine and banded in gold, a flower at its collar, and a small bow for everybody.
prongs.habit: It learns the name of everyone in a room in a minute, and uses each exactly once.

finishes.name: Master of Revels
finishes.of: one who will see everybody fed and merry, by force if need be
finishes.text: It keeps the table. Nobody has left it hungry, or early, and one or two have not been allowed to leave it at all.
finishes.sign: A wreath of leaves hung between wide horns, a great coat like a bell, and a cup that is somehow always full.
finishes.habit: It fills your cup when you are not looking, and looks hurt when you notice.

finishes.name: Honest Enemy
finishes.of: one who is perfectly civil to those it means to ruin
finishes.text: It bows to the named beast before every meeting, and means it. Then it does what it came to do.
finishes.sign: A half-mask over its eyes, a tail as thin as a sword with a barb to it, and its wings folded like the tails of a coat.
finishes.habit: It sends word ahead. It thinks it only fair that the thing should know who is coming.

paths.name: Head-down
paths.of: one who settles it by being the larger
paths.text: It learned from you that some things are not argued with. It puts its head down and goes through them, and is larger on the far side.
paths.sign: Its horns have come forward and its shoulders up round them. It looks at a shut door the way others look at an open one.
paths.habit: It leans on things to see if they will hold: fences, doors, you.

prongs.name: Gate-ram
prongs.text: It knocks once, with its head. What is behind the door has usually reconsidered by the time the dust settles.
prongs.sign: A ram's horns curled close at its temples, and a brow like a doorstep. There is plaster in its hair.
prongs.habit: It opens doors with its forehead, even when they were not shut.

finishes.name: Wall-goer
finishes.of: one who has stopped going round things
finishes.text: It has stopped going round. It goes from where it is to where the thing is, and the walls between are its own affair.
finishes.sign: The two horns have grown forward and met in a single boss, like the head of a ram for breaking gates.
finishes.habit: It walks through hedges. It could use the gap. It has seen the gap.

finishes.name: Gate-crasher
finishes.of: one who was not asked, and came, and was right to
finishes.text: It was not sent for. It arrives through the nearest shut thing at the moment it is needed, and expects no thanks, and wants some.
finishes.sign: A bull's horns set wide, with half a gate still hanging from the left one. It has not noticed, or will not admit to it.
finishes.habit: It turns up at the end of every quarrel you did not tell it about.

prongs.name: Strong Arm
prongs.of: one who takes hold, and lets that be the argument
prongs.text: It does not hit things much. It takes hold of them and waits, and they come round to its way of thinking.
prongs.sign: Hands the size of its head on arms like a smith's, and a bull's horns set wide and low.
prongs.habit: It shakes hands for slightly too long, to learn what it needs to.

finishes.name: Arms Folded
finishes.of: one who can refuse a thing and do it in the same breath
finishes.text: It has four arms now. Two are folded, and say no. The other two have already started on what you asked.
finishes.sign: Four arms: the upper pair folded tight across its chest, the lower pair free, and busy.
finishes.habit: It says it will not help you move the table, from the far end of the table, lifting.

finishes.name: Yoke-breaker
finishes.of: one who was put in harness once, and only once
finishes.text: Somebody put a yoke on it, once. It wears the half that is left, to remind people how that went.
finishes.sign: Half a broken yoke round its neck with a length of chain swinging from it, and a ring in its nose, pulled open.
finishes.habit: It will carry anything for you, and nothing at all if you tell it to.

prongs.name: Sharp-set
prongs.of: one who is hungry, and has stopped apologising for it
prongs.text: It is always a little hungry, and it has found that the feeling points. It follows where it points, at a trot.
prongs.sign: Lean where its kin are broad, with a stag's horns, a long whip of a tail and its nose to the wind.
prongs.habit: It knows what is for supper before you do, and what was for supper next door.

finishes.name: Horn-wreath
finishes.of: one who keeps something of everything it ran down
finishes.text: It has kept a horn from every named beast it ran down, and wears them. The wreath is nearly round.
finishes.sign: A wreath of horns, no two alike, lies over its own from brow to nape and down between its shoulders.
finishes.habit: It counts the horns with one finger at night, and stops at the gap, and looks at you.

finishes.name: Never Full
finishes.of: one whose hunger has outgrown what it had to keep it in
finishes.text: It ran down everything it wanted and went on wanting. There is more appetite to it now than body, and it thins to smoke at the edges.
finishes.sign: A great jaw, a rack of ribs, and from the knees and the elbows out it is smoke with embers in. It is quite cheerful.
finishes.habit: It eats the candle ends. It eats the string. It asks, politely, whether you are finishing that.
